remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Backing inscription may indicate date of preparatory work. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert. Downtown Gallery to Nordness, March 1962." See cat. nos. 1429–37. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A yellow form arches across the canvas. Two small tendrils emanate from the form. Above and below the larger shape is a softly shaded, abstract blue and purple background.
